result:
Comment authors can now edit their own comments. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with `{ body }`. The mutation hook shows the "Comment Updated" success notification in `onSuccess` and invalidates the discussion's comments query.
- **Edit button and drawer:** `features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx` has an "Edit Comment" button that opens a form drawer with a body textarea.
- **Comments list:** `comments-list.tsx` shows the button only when the new `comment:update` policy passes, meaning the comment's author is the current user.
- **Policy:** `lib/authorization.tsx` has the new `comment:update` entry. It is author-only, so admins don't get an Edit button on other people's comments.
- **Mock handler:** `testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts` has a new PATCH handler. It only updates a comment when its `authorId` matches the logged-in user.

The Edit and Delete buttons sit inside the existing delete-policy `Authorization` block. So the Edit button only appears when the delete policy also passes, which it always does for the author.
